overview: Close the remaining chat gaps between the web chunter/chat experience and the Expo mobile app: channel lifecycle and membership actions, settings, pins, history navigation, typing, message edit/delete, DM/group-DM creation, richer compose, thread browsing, saved messages, presence, mute controls, persistent drafts, and video-message support.

scopeCuts: Focus on chat parity inside mobile chat routes, hooks, store, repository, and realtime rules
Exclude workbench-only side panels, inline comments, and mail/notifier presentation surfaces

prerequisites: Existing scaffold/auth/api client/chat phases are already implemented in mobile/
mobile-attachments should be complete before attachment-heavy channel/thread parity is called done
The existing websocket sidecar under mobile/src/store/websocket.ts and mobile/src/realtime/** must remain available for realtime-driven parity tasks
nonGoals: Recreating every Svelte side panel from workbench chat
Rewriting the chat domain away from the current repository/query/store architecture
Delivering new server-side chat models beyond what mobile already consumes
contracts: Server state remains in TanStack Query; ephemeral draft/unread/typing state remains in Zustand
New chat routes stay under mobile/src/app/(app)/chat/**
Thread and channel timelines must not diverge on message identity, reaction ownership, or cache keys
Channel settings shell must own the navigation contract for members, pins, history, and edit flows
Downstream parity tasks may implement destination routes and mutations, but they must not re-own the settings-shell entrypoint contract
Typing parity must use the existing websocket sidecar as the event transport instead of inventing a polling-only workaround

tasks.title: Expand chat repository parity contract
tasks.description: Add repository methods for channel detail, members, pinned messages, channel updates, DM conversion, history search/jump, and thread-message correctness.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository exposes typed methods for channel detail, members, pinned messages, channel update, DM conversion, message-history search, message edit/delete, DM/group-DM creation, and saved messages.
Thread fetch/send paths distinguish parent timeline messages from thread replies instead of returning ambiguous mixed payloads.
Removed or inaccessible channels return typed empty/failure states instead of crashing dependent screens.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && rg -n "pinned|history|edit|delete|saved|dm|group" src/repositories/chat.ts

tasks.title: Extend chat hooks for parity queries and mutations
tasks.description: Wire the expanded repository contract into TanStack Query so channel settings, pins, history search, and thread correctness all share the same cache model.
acceptanceCriteria: Hooks expose channel-detail, pinned-message, and history-search queries without screens calling repositories directly.
Pin/unpin, channel-update, DM-conversion, and thread-reaction mutations invalidate the exact channel or thread keys they affect.
Thread reaction and reply mutations update both active thread and parent channel caches consistently.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && rg -n "invalidateQueries|queryKey|thread" src/hooks/useChannels.ts src/hooks/useMessages.ts src/hooks/useThread.ts

tasks.title: Fix chat unread and ephemeral state contract
tasks.description: Expand chat client state so unread, draft attachment, and chat-realtime state are consistent across the app shell and WS invalidation rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Unread sync uses the correct account identity and rebuilds unread state from fresh server contexts.
Realtime chat invalidation does not leave stale unread counts behind after channel/message mutations.
Draft attachment and unread state clear on workspace switch instead of leaking into the next session.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && rg -n "unread|draft|workspace" src/store/chat.ts src/hooks/useChatUnread.ts src/realtime/rules/chat.ts

tasks.title: Add active conversation lifecycle wiring
tasks.description: Make channel and thread routes explicitly own active-conversation registration so unread and thread semantics can distinguish what the user is actually viewing.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening a channel or thread registers an active conversation state that distinguishes channel timeline from thread view.
Self-generated replies in the currently-open conversation do not increment unread counts.
Active conversation state clears on route teardown and back navigation instead of persisting into the next chat route.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && rg -n "setActive|active.*thread|active.*channel" 'src/app/(app)/chat/channel/[id].tsx' 'src/app/(app)/chat/thread/[id].tsx' src/store/chat.ts

tasks.title: Add channel header and settings shell
tasks.description: Add a first-class channel settings route and make it the owner of downstream settings navigation for members, pins, history, and edit flows.
acceptanceCriteria: Channel screen header exposes navigation into a typed settings route.
Settings route supports channel name, description, privacy, and basic metadata display/edit.
Settings shell owns stable rows/navigation targets for members, pins, history, and edit flows, even if some downstream routes arrive in later tasks.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && test -f 'src/app/(app)/chat/channel/settings/[id].tsx' && test -f 'src/components/features/ChannelHeader.tsx' && rg -n "members|pins|history|edit" 'src/app/(app)/chat/channel/settings/[id].tsx' src/components/features/ChannelHeader.tsx

tasks.title: Add channel members and DM conversion flow
tasks.description: Bring member visibility and DM-to-private-channel conversion to mobile so channel collaboration flows match web behavior more closely.
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile exposes a members route from channel settings with readable participant rows and empty/error states.
DM surfaces expose a conversion path to private channel only when the repository reports the action is valid.
Failed member fetches or conversion attempts do not leave the channel list in a stale optimistic state.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && test -f 'src/app/(app)/chat/channel/members/[id].tsx' && test -f 'src/components/features/ChannelMemberRow.tsx' && rg -n "convert|members|private channel|dm" 'src/app/(app)/chat/channel/members/[id].tsx' 'src/app/(app)/chat/index.tsx'

tasks.title: Add pinned messages parity
tasks.description: Bring pinned-message browsing and unpin flow to mobile through the settings shell and dedicated pins screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Channel settings route exposes pinned-message browsing through a dedicated pins screen.
Pinned list renders stable previews that navigate back to the underlying message or thread context.
Removing a pin updates the pinned list and source timeline without requiring a full channel refetch.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && test -f 'src/app/(app)/chat/channel/pins/[id].tsx' && test -f 'src/components/features/PinnedMessageRow.tsx' && rg -n "pin|unpin" 'src/app/(app)/chat/channel/settings/[id].tsx' 'src/app/(app)/chat/channel/pins/[id].tsx'

tasks.title: Bring thread flow to parity-correctness
tasks.description: Correct the thread model and screen behavior so thread replies, reactions, and attachments behave like a real thread surface instead of a channel-side variant.
acceptanceCriteria: Thread screen reads and mutates thread-specific cache keys, including reactions and reply inserts.
Reply creation uses the correct thread semantics so replies do not leak back into the main channel timeline.
Thread attachment and reaction actions update the active thread view immediately and recover cleanly on failure.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && rg -n "thread|reply|attachment|reaction" src/repositories/chat.ts src/hooks/useThread.ts 'src/app/(app)/chat/thread/[id].tsx'

tasks.title: Add channel history search and jump-to-date
tasks.description: Expose history navigation beyond infinite scroll so mobile users can find older conversation context like they can on web. TASK-005 owns the settings-shell entry row; this task owns the destination route, history query behavior, and jump semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Searchable message history integrates with the settings-shell entrypoint established in TASK-005 without collapsing the main message list state.
Jump-to-date loads the nearest history window and lands the user on a stable anchor message.
When the requested history window has no results, the UI reports that explicitly instead of silently resetting to newest messages.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && test -f 'src/app/(app)/chat/channel/search/[id].tsx' && test -f 'src/components/features/JumpToDatePicker.tsx' && rg -n "jump|history|search" 'src/app/(app)/chat/channel/search/[id].tsx' src/hooks/useMessages.ts

tasks.title: Add channel create/edit surfaces
tasks.description: Bring mobile up to basic channel administration parity so users can create channels and edit existing channel metadata without leaving mobile.
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile exposes typed routes for creating a channel and editing an existing channel.
Channel form supports name, description, privacy, and member selection with validation.
Save failures keep the form open with recoverable field or transport errors instead of dropping the user back to the list.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && test -f 'src/app/(app)/chat/new.tsx' && test -f 'src/app/(app)/chat/edit/[id].tsx' && test -f 'src/components/features/ChannelForm.tsx'

tasks.title: Add typing indicator parity
tasks.description: Use the existing websocket sidecar as the event transport for typing participants in channel view.
acceptanceCriteria: Channel view renders typing participants only for the active conversation and clears them on navigation away.
Typing state is sourced from the websocket sidecar and degrades cleanly when websocket connectivity is unavailable.
Typing updates do not trigger full timeline refetches or duplicate unread-count changes.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && test -f 'src/components/features/TypingIndicator.tsx' && rg -n "typing" 'src/app/(app)/chat/channel/[id].tsx' src/components/features/TypingIndicator.tsx src/realtime/TransactorConnection.ts

tasks.title: Add message edit and delete
tasks.description: Add edit and delete actions to messages in channel and thread views via long-press context menu.
acceptanceCriteria: Long-press on a message authored by the current user shows Edit and Delete actions; messages by others show only Delete if the user has moderation rights.
Edit opens an inline editor pre-populated with the message content; saving updates the message and shows an edited indicator with timestamp.
Delete shows a confirmation dialog; successful deletion removes the message from the timeline with optimistic cache update and proper invalidation.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && rg -n "edit|delete|edited" 'src/app/(app)/chat/channel/[id].tsx' src/components/features/MessageBubble.tsx src/repositories/chat.ts

tasks.title: Add create DM and group DM flow
tasks.description: Allow users to initiate new direct message and group DM conversations from the chat list.
acceptanceCriteria: Chat list exposes a New Message entry point that opens a member selector with search for starting 1:1 or group DMs.
Selecting members and confirming creates the DM/group-DM via the repository and navigates to the new conversation.
If a DM with the selected member already exists, navigates to the existing conversation instead of creating a duplicate.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && test -f 'src/app/(app)/chat/new-dm.tsx' && test -f 'src/components/features/MemberSelector.tsx' && rg -n "New Message|group|duplicate|existing" 'src/app/(app)/chat/new-dm.tsx' 'src/app/(app)/chat/index.tsx'

tasks.title: Add rich text editor toolbar and @mention insertion
tasks.description: Upgrade the shared chat message composer with a formatting toolbar and inline @mention picker.
acceptanceCriteria: The shared composer used by both channel and thread screens shows a toolbar with bold, italic, code, and link formatting actions that wrap selected text or insert markers at cursor.
Typing @ triggers a searchable member suggestions overlay; selecting a member inserts a mention reference that renders as a tappable chip.
Formatted content serializes to the same markup format the server expects and renders correctly via MarkupRenderer on receipt.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && test -f 'src/components/features/RichTextEditor.tsx' && test -f 'src/components/features/MentionSuggestions.tsx' && rg -n "mention|bold|italic|code|link" src/components/features/MessageInput.tsx src/components/features/RichTextEditor.tsx src/components/features/MentionSuggestions.tsx

tasks.title: Add thread browsing (all threads view)
tasks.description: Add a threads list screen accessible from the chat tab showing all active threads across channels.
acceptanceCriteria: Chat tab exposes a threads entry point that lists all threads the user participates in, sorted by latest reply.
Each row shows the parent message preview, reply count, last reply timestamp, and channel name.
Tapping a thread row navigates to the existing thread screen; empty state shows when the user has no active threads.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && test -f 'src/app/(app)/chat/threads.tsx' && rg -n "threads|router|Thread" 'src/app/(app)/chat/index.tsx' 'src/app/(app)/chat/threads.tsx' src/hooks/useThread.ts

tasks.title: Add online/presence status
tasks.description: Show user online/offline status indicators on channel members, DM headers, and message avatars.
acceptanceCriteria: AvatarCircle renders a green dot overlay when the user is online, sourced from presence data via the WebSocket sidecar.
DM conversation header shows the other user's presence status (online/offline/last seen).
Presence degrades gracefully when WebSocket is disconnected — shows no indicator instead of stale online status.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && test -f 'src/hooks/usePresence.ts' && rg -n "presence|online|last seen" src/components/ui/AvatarCircle.tsx src/hooks/usePresence.ts src/realtime/TransactorConnection.ts

tasks.title: Add saved/bookmarked messages
tasks.description: Allow users to save messages for later reference and browse saved messages from a dedicated screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Long-press on any message shows a Save action; saved messages are stored server-side via the existing savedMessages API.
A Saved Messages screen accessible from the chat list shows all bookmarked messages with channel context and timestamp.
Tapping a saved message navigates to the source channel/thread; unsaving removes it from the list with optimistic update.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && test -f 'src/app/(app)/chat/saved.tsx' && test -f 'src/components/features/SavedMessageRow.tsx' && rg -n "saved|bookmark|unsave" 'src/app/(app)/chat/index.tsx' 'src/app/(app)/chat/saved.tsx'

tasks.title: Add per-channel mute/notification settings
tasks.description: Allow users to mute channels or customize notification preferences per conversation.
acceptanceCriteria: Channel settings shell includes a mute toggle that suppresses push and in-app notifications for the channel.
Muted channels show a mute icon in the channel list and do not contribute to the unread badge count.
Mute state persists server-side so it syncs across devices and survives app reinstalls.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && rg -n "mute|notification" 'src/app/(app)/chat/channel/settings/[id].tsx' src/repositories/chat.ts src/hooks/useChannels.ts

tasks.title: Persist message drafts to storage
tasks.description: Upgrade in-memory chat drafts to persist across app restarts via AsyncStorage.
acceptanceCriteria: Message drafts persist to AsyncStorage keyed by channel/thread id and restore when the user returns to the conversation.
Drafts clear on successful message send and on workspace switch.
Draft indicator (pencil icon) shows in the channel list for conversations with unsent drafts.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && rg -n "draft|AsyncStorage|pencil" src/store/chat.ts 'src/app/(app)/chat/channel/[id].tsx' 'src/app/(app)/chat/thread/[id].tsx'

tasks.title: Add channel lifecycle and membership actions
tasks.description: Close the remaining channel administration gap by adding join/leave plus archive/delete actions to the settings shell and list surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Channel settings exposes join/leave actions where appropriate and archive/delete actions when the current user has permission.
Archive/delete mutations remove or update the affected conversation in the chat list without leaving stale routes behind.
Join/leave and archive/delete failures show recoverable errors and do not desynchronize list membership state.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && rg -n "join|leave|archive|delete" 'src/app/(app)/chat/channel/settings/[id].tsx' 'src/app/(app)/chat/index.tsx' src/repositories/chat.ts

tasks.title: Add video message support
tasks.description: Close the remaining media gap by rendering video attachments and messages with an explicit playback path instead of generic file-only handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Video attachments and messages render with a recognizable inline preview and play affordance inside channel and thread timelines.
Opening a video launches a stable playback surface with loading, error, and unsupported-format fallbacks.
Non-video attachments keep their current behavior and video detection does not misclassify images or generic files.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && test -f 'src/components/features/VideoMessage.tsx' && rg -n "video|playback|unsupported" src/components/features/MessageBubble.tsx src/components/features/AttachmentViewer.tsx src/components/features/VideoMessage.tsx

failureModes.failure: Thread reaction updates the wrong cache
failureModes.detection: Reaction changes do not appear in the open thread
failureModes.recovery: Invalidate and patch the thread cache directly, not only the channel cache

failureModes.failure: DM conversion succeeds server-side but list stays stale
failureModes.detection: Converted conversation remains rendered as a DM
failureModes.recovery: Invalidate DM and channel list keys together after conversion

failureModes.detection: Typing names remain visible after navigation
failureModes.recovery: Clear typing state on active-channel change and route teardown

failureModes.failure: History search returns message ids without stable anchor context
failureModes.detection: Jump opens wrong part of the conversation
failureModes.recovery: Carry anchor metadata and refetch the surrounding history window before navigation

failureModes.detection: Pin state differs between pins screen and source message context
failureModes.recovery: Treat pin/unpin as a shared mutation contract with one invalidation owner

failureModes.detection: User edits while another user replies
failureModes.recovery: Optimistic update uses message version; server rejects stale edits with clear error

failureModes.detection: Two users create DM with each other simultaneously
failureModes.recovery: Repository checks existing DMs before creating; navigates to existing if found

failureModes.detection: AsyncStorage write races with send completion
failureModes.recovery: Clear draft synchronously on send initiation, not on server confirmation
Presence hook clears all status on disconnect event

failureModes.failure: Channel archive/delete leaves stale list state
failureModes.detection: Removed channel still appears in list or remains open
failureModes.recovery: Invalidate chat list and redirect away from inaccessible channel after successful mutation

failureModes.failure: Video message fails on unsupported media
failureModes.detection: User taps video and sees blank surface
failureModes.recovery: Show explicit unsupported/error state and preserve download/view fallback
